sources.snippet: Swin2SR model (image super-resolution) Swin2SR model that upscales images x4. It was introduced in the paper Swin2SR: SwinV2 Transformer for Compressed Image Super-Resolution and Restoration by Conde et al. and first released in this repository. Intended use cases This model is intended for real-world image super resolution. Usage Refer to the documentation.

sources.snippet: What is swin2SR-realworld-sr-x4-64-bsrgan-psnr? This is a specialized image super-resolution model based on the Swin2SR architecture, designed specifically for real-world image enhancement. It leverages the power of SwinV2 Transformer technology to upscale images by a factor of 4, while maintaining image quality through BSRGAN optimization and PSNR metrics.
